milestone: SignBridge M8 — Sign Coverage & Translation Reliability

NAMASTE.description: Two-handed greeting: palms pressed flat together at center chest (Anjali Mudra), slight respectful head bow (ISLRTC Vol 1, Word #0001, GODL License)

HELLO.description: Open flat hand raised to temple/chest, gentle outward forward arc

THANK_YOU.description: Flat dominant hand touching chin/lips, moving downward and forward

PLEASE.description: Flat open hand rubbing clockwise over center of chest

WELCOME.description: Both open hands held forward palms up, drawn smoothly toward body

SORRY.description: Closed dominant fist rubbing circular on chest

YES.description: Dominant fist nodding downward at wrist

YOU.description: Dominant index finger pointing forward toward addressee

I.description: Dominant index finger pointing toward center of signer chest

HELP.description: Closed dominant fist resting on open flat non-dominant palm

BAD.description: Dominant pinky extended or hand turned palm down with downward thrust

STOP.description: Open flat dominant hand coming down sharply onto open non-dominant palm

WAIT.description: Open hands held outward at waist height, fingers fluttering

isl_namaste_godl_v1.provenance: Hand-authored geometric approximation based on ISLRTC Vol 1, Word #0001 (data.gov.in / GODL)

technicallyPlayableAwaitingReview.reason: Articulates bilateral prayer pose and head nod on Y-Bot WebGL canvas; clean-room authored under GODL; awaiting certified Deaf-native human panel validation.
Evaluated in M3.9/M3.10 retargeting tests; passes declarative schema validation; isolated from production registry.
Rig verification motion; explicitly flagged isLinguisticISL=false.
